requirements.title: Provisional Admission Allotment Letter & Fee Advance Receipt
requirements.description: Official seat allotment letter issued through entrance examination / counseling portal with tuition fee payment receipt.

requirements.title: Entrance Exam Score Card / Rank Card (VITEEE / MET / SRMJEEE / JEE Main)
requirements.description: Official entrance examination scorecard / rank card indicating candidate merit rank.

requirements.title: Class XII Mark Sheet (Minimum 60% Aggregate in PCM/PCB)
requirements.description: Original Class 12 / Higher Secondary mark sheet showing at least 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics/Biology.

requirements.title: Class X Mark Sheet / Certificate (Age & DOB Proof)
requirements.description: Original 10th standard certificate proving candidate full name and date of birth.

requirements.title: Transfer Certificate (TC) & Migration Certificate
requirements.description: Original Transfer / School Leaving Certificate and Migration Certificate from the board/council.
requirements.source_name: Quora Physical Reporting Threads & Campus Portal

requirements.title: Community / Nativity Certificate (For Reserved & Fee Concession Categories)
requirements.description: Original community certificate / nativity certificate issued by revenue authority (if applicable).

requirements.title: Affidavit by Student & Parent (Anti-Ragging & Code of Conduct)
requirements.description: Online UGC anti-ragging affidavit acknowledgment receipt and signed institutional code of conduct undertaking.

requirements.title: Physical Fitness Certificate
requirements.description: Medical fitness certificate issued by an authorized medical practitioner along with blood group record.

requirements.title: Aadhaar Card Copy / Government Photo ID
requirements.description: Clear copy of Aadhaar card of candidate and parent/guardian.

requirements.title: Recent Passport Size Photographs (8 copies)
requirements.description: Color photographs in formal attire on light background.
requirements.source_name: Quora Student Advice & Campus Onboarding Checklist
